description: Na₂VOF₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one O and six F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.83 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one O and five F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.37 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.55 Å. V is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form distorted edge-sharing VOF₅ octahedra. The V-O bond length is 1.65 Å. There are a spread of V-F bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.27 Å. O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na and one V atom. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form FNa₃V tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNa₃V tetrahedra, corners with seven FNa₃V trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂V₂ trigonal pyramid. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to three equivalent Na and one V atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing FNa₃V trigonal pyramids. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to two Na and two equivalent V atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂V₂ trigonal pyramids.
